name: io.github.theluckystrike/avalanche-forecast-danger-rating-mcp
title: Avalanche Forecast and Danger Rating MCP
description: Avalanche forecast: danger rating by zone and elevation, problems and bottom line (avalanche.org)

tools.name: avalanche_forecast
tools.description: The current avalanche forecast for a mountain place ("Alta, UT", "Snoqualmie Pass", "Mount Hood"), a forecast zone name ("Tetons", "Salt Lake") or latitude and longitude: the danger rating (1 Low to 5 Extreme) and travel advice, danger above, near and below treeline for today and tomorrow when the center issues them, avalanche problems (type, likelihood, size, aspects and elevations), the bottom line or early-season summary, issue and expiry times, and the full forecast link. Covers every zone on avalanche.org (AK, AZ, CA, CO, ID, MT, NH, NM, NY, OR, UT, WA, WY).

place.description: A mountain town, pass, peak or "lat,lon", for example "Alta, UT" or "Girdwood, AK".

zone.description: A forecast zone name instead of a place, for example "Stevens Pass", "Tetons" or "Bridger Range".

latitude.description: Latitude, with longitude, instead of a place.

center.description: Limit zone and place matching to one center id, for example NWAC, UAC, CAIC, SAC, GNFAC.

include_discussion.description: Also return the forecaster's hazard discussion (plain text, up to 3,000 characters).

tools.name: avalanche_danger_map
tools.description: Current avalanche danger for every US avalanche forecast zone (about 90 zones from about 30 centers), or one state or center, sorted highest first, with counts by danger level, off-season zones, the validity window of each rating and avalanche warnings.

state.description: US state, 2-letter code or name, for example WA, UT or Colorado.

center.description: One avalanche center id, for example NWAC, UAC, CAIC, SNFAC.

min_level.description: Only zones at or above this danger level, 1 Low to 5 Extreme.

rated_only.description: Only zones that have a danger rating right now.

tools.name: avalanche_centers
tools.description: US avalanche centers (all, or in one state) with their forecast zones, website, time zone and season status: issuing danger ratings, in season without a rating today, or off season, plus the highest current danger.

state.description: US state, 2-letter code or name, for example WA, UT or Colorado.
